crossRefs.note: “But come what may,” he said, “I will run.” He said to him, “Run!” Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the Plain, and outran…
then the priest shall examine the plague; and behold, if its appearance is deeper than the skin, and the hair in it is…
Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.
translations.bsb: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
translations.kjv: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
translations.asv: And they ran both together: and the other disciple outran Peter, and came first to the tomb;
